An original universal world / TEN CHAPTERS

Lantern Harbor

Rook’s home is a fictional harbor of roof gardens, couriers, libraries, and bridges. These ten adventures establish the friends and values he carries into every world.

Travel note: A harbor footpath becomes a caravan road toward the Garden of Many Doors. · All worlds
